# AL1700: Anonymous function can be made static

<!-- <auto-generated /> This file is generated by tools/ANcpLua.Analyzers.DocsGenerator. -->

| Category | `Usage` |

| Analyzer | `Al1700PreferStaticLambdaAnalyzer` |

## Description

Lambda expressions and anonymous methods that don't capture variables should be marked 'static' to avoid unnecessary allocations and improve performance.
